disposition_reason: Clean Label Project 2025 protein powder report; chocolate appears only as a flavour category of protein powders (chocolate-flavoured powders had about 4x more lead and 110x more cadmium than vanilla; 65% over Prop 65 lead). Composite protein powders with chocolate flavour are out of scope; no cocoa or chocolate concentrations reported.
disposition_locator: PDF p.2 (summary: chocolate-flavoured powders four times more lead); PDF p.4 and p.6 (65% of chocolate protein powders over Prop 65); PDF p.7 (110x more cadmium than vanilla); PDF p.9 (recommendation of non-chocolate powders)

study.material_scope: protein powders by protein source and flavour (composite)
